name: Xianheng International Science&Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Xianheng International Science&Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, procurement, production, sale, and marketing of Maintenance, Repair, and Operation (MRO) products. The company offers technical services, such as electrical equipment condition monitoring, non-destructive testing, operation and maintenance inspections, fire protection and security inspection, and drone-assisted X-ray inspection; and solutions such as unmanned operation solutions, cable simulation and training solutions, digital one-stop warehousing solutions, safety sensory training rooms, and embodied intelligent inspection systems.
